resources.string: Separate attachment and voice buttons. Turn off to use the standard Telegram bar.
In every chat, Saved Messages included: back with the unread count, a centred title and an avatar that opens the chat menu.
The profile colour fills the whole screen; cards, text and icons adapt to it.
A darkened photo behind the avatar and group title. No photo means no banner.
Fit the bar to the number of visible tabs
Place the title capsule in the center of the header
Fit the capsule to the title and status
